title: Chrome graphics input validation weakened an isolation boundary
summary: One Chrome graphics report earned USD 250,000 across two award decisions.
root_cause: The graphics translation layer insufficiently validated untrusted input.
impact: Insufficiently validated graphics input could cross a browser security boundary; the vendor classified the issue High.
defensive_takeaways: Validate untrusted graphics inputs at security boundaries and verify that mitigations cover all relevant input paths.
Distinguish issue-status fixes from stable-release availability.

reward.evidence_quote: award you $25000.00 for this report … award you $225000.00 for this report
reward.evidence_location: Public Chromium issue comments #25 and #30; ellipsis joins excerpts.
reward.notes: USD 25,000 on June 4 plus USD 225,000 on June 29 for one report. Case notices use $; USD is contextual from the official Chromium program source. No currency conversion or cash-receipt claim.

published.note: Full report access restrictions removed; vendor release notice appeared earlier.

public_disclosure.note: Vendor release disclosure; full issue access was enabled later.

fixed.note: Documented stable release; issue was marked Fixed 2026-05-27. Backport availability may differ.

award_announced.note: Per-issue reward listed in the public release notice.
